text: 金融强国“十五五”规划出台：央行详解货币政策、人民币国际化等改革方向 “十五五”时期我国将推进金融高水平对外开放，推进人民币国际化，拓展人民币在国际贸易和投融资中的作用。
text_en: The financial powerhouse plan for the 15th Five-Year Plan is introduced: the PBOC explains in detail reform directions including monetary policy and renminbi internationalization. During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, China will advance high-level financial opening-up, promote renminbi internationalization, and expand the role of the renminbi in international trade and investment and financing.
